''See also: [[Fury Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Fury is a powerful combatant and a member of a prominent family, known for his massive physical presence, wild shadowy hair, and glowing red eyes. He is the son of [[Malice]], born before she attained the rank of [[Monarch]], and is the father of the [[Sage]] [[Charity]]. As the only direct descendant of [[Malice]] to reach the level of [[Herald]], he was her preferred child. He is married to an [[Archlady]] named Aunt Naria{{!}}Naria and has achieved the status of an [[Icon]], with his power advancing toward [[Monarch]]. In combat, Fury is characterized by an intense love for fighting and a tendency to find joy in battle. He possesses significant experience, surpassed only by certain [[Monarchs]], and utilizes [[Abidan]] armor along with [[Wolf Division]] techniques to augment his abilities. He can fly using [[soulfire]] and Wind aura{{!}}wind aura, and he is capable of moving with great speed while utilizing [[madra]] and [[Way-power]]. Despite his intimidating appearance, which has led some cultures to view him as a monster, he can be bright, conversational, and even sheepish. He often shows interest in those he perceives as having potential and has a history of driving off [[Dreadgod cults]].}}
